01Brief History of The Polytechnic Ibadan
⌄

The Polytechnic Ibadan was established in 1970 as a successor to the erstwhile Technical College Ibadan, under the provisions of a principal edict. The Polytechnic Ibadan edict 1970 cited this as the principal edict.

The primary function of the polytechnic is to provide students training and development of techniques in applied science, engineering, environmental science and commerce. The graduates of the polytechnic Ibadan are found in almost all areas of endeavour all over the country and even outside the country. Some of them have become captains of industries and commerce.

The principal officers of the polytechnic constitute the core of the management of the institution. They are the Rector, Deputy Rector, Registrar, Bursar, Chief Librarian and Director of Works.

03Head of Department Welcome Address
⌄

It is with great pleasure and a deep sense of responsibility that I welcome you to the Department of Science Laboratory Technology (SLT), one of the foremost and most dynamic departments in The Polytechnic, Ibadan.

Over the years, our department has grown remarkably, not only in student population but also in academic quality, infrastructural development, and professional relevance. We have achieved significant milestones — the completion and use of one wing of our newly constructed laboratory, acquisition of modern computer systems, the introduction of project defence for our students, and the establishment of a departmental wear that promotes identity and unity among our students.

Our commitment to academic excellence remains unwavering. The department boasts a team of qualified and dedicated lecturers who combine experience, innovation, and passion to deliver quality instruction and mentorship. We continuously update our curriculum to meet global standards and ensure our graduates are well-equipped to contribute meaningfully to the scientific and technological advancement of Nigeria and the world at large.

While we celebrate our achievements, we also recognize areas that require improvement, such as the need for more staff and further expansion of our laboratory facilities. We are optimistic that with the continued support of the management of The Polytechnic Ibadan, and the cooperation of our industrious staff and students, the department will attain even greater heights.

To our students — past, present, and prospective — we say: Science is the foundation of innovation, and the laboratory is where possibilities are born. We encourage you to remain curious, disciplined, and committed to excellence.

On behalf of the entire staff, I welcome you once again to the Department of Science Laboratory Technology, where knowledge meets discovery, and learning inspires innovation.

Kolawole Tolulope
B.Tech (App. Physics)  |  MSc (Phy)  |  MNIP
Head of Department, Science Laboratory Technology
04About the SLT Programme
⌄

Science Laboratory Technology (SLT) is a National Diploma programme accredited by the National Board for Technical Education (NBTE). At The Polytechnic Ibadan, the programme runs under the Faculty of Science and admits students through JAMB and direct entry routes.

The programme blends theoretical study with heavy laboratory practice across chemistry, biology, physics, and specialised SLT labs. The goal is to produce competent laboratory technologists who can work in any scientific setting.

Duration

Two years (four semesters) leading to a National Diploma (ND). Strong CGPA graduates may proceed to Higher National Diploma (HND) or degree programmes.

SIWES

Students must undergo the Students Industrial Work Experience Scheme (SIWES) — a period of industrial attachment in relevant industries and laboratories. SIWES is compulsory for the award of the National Diploma.

Attendance Requirement

Students must attend at least 70% of lectures and practical sessions per semester. Failure to meet this disqualifies a student from sitting exams in the affected course(s).

05Admission Requirements
⌄

Five O’Level credits including Mathematics, English Language, Chemistry, Biology or Physics and any other Science subject. Credits must be obtained in not more than two sittings.

JAMB score meeting The Polytechnic Ibadan’s cut-off mark for SLT. Pass Post-UTME screening where applicable.

07Career Opportunities
⌄

Hospital Laboratories — Medical lab technologist, haematology, microbiology, pathology labs.

Pharmaceutical Industry — Quality control, drug manufacturing, pharmaceutical laboratories.

Research Institutions — NAFDAC, PRODA, research institutes, university laboratories.

Food & Beverage — Food safety testing, quality assurance, production labs.

Petroleum Industry — NNPC, oil servicing companies, chemical analysis.

Environmental Labs — Water quality testing, environmental monitoring agencies.

Education — Lab technician in schools, polytechnics and universities.

Government Agencies — Standards Organisation of Nigeria (SON), NAFDAC, DPR.

🎓

Graduation / Award Classes

ND graduation class is determined by your Cumulative Grade Point Average (CGPA) at the end of four semesters.

Class of Award CGPA Range
🏆 Distinction 3.50 – 4.00
⭐ Upper Credit 3.00 – 3.49
✅ Lower Credit 2.50 – 2.99
📄 Pass 2.00 – 2.49
